name: OK-03
label: Safe R

key_factors: Longtime incumbent Frank Lucas running for re-election
Democratic challenger Suzie Byrd has no reported fundraising
Prediction markets price Lucas at about 96% to win
model.rationale: This western Oklahoma seat leans heavily Republican, and Frank Lucas is a well-established incumbent with over $500,000 on hand while his challenger reports no fundraising. With no polls or expert ratings available, the fundamentals and market pricing both point to an easy Lucas win.
model.watch: A major scandal or unexpected incumbent retirement would be the only realistic path to making this competitive.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Oklahoma's 3rd District is one of the most Republican-leaning seats in the country, with a partisan lean of R+23. Frank Lucas, a veteran incumbent first elected decades ago, is running for re-election with a substantial war chest of about $530,000 and no outside groups targeting the race.

His Democratic opponent, Suzie Byrd, has no reported fundraising or cash on hand, and no public polls or expert ratings exist for the race. Prediction markets give Lucas roughly a 96% chance of winning. The forecast rates the district as Safe Republican, with Lucas heavily favored to return to Congress.
